subject: biology
title: Sorting Living Things
welcome_lead: Group every living thing on Earth into kingdoms, vertebrates and invertebrates.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on classification, kingdoms and vertebrate groups.
final_note: You can now sort organisms into kingdoms and tell vertebrates from invertebrates.

concepts.def: Vertebrate with fur that feeds milk.

walkthroughs.body_html: Living things are sorted into kingdoms: animals, plants, fungi, single-celled organisms (protists) and bacteria. Each kingdom shares key features.
Vertebrates have a backbone (mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish). Invertebrates do not (insects, worms, spiders, jellyfish).
Five groups: mammals (fur, milk), birds (feathers, eggs), reptiles (scales, eggs), amphibians (moist skin, eggs in water), fish (scales, gills).
